## Game 1 find your seat

```{r game01}
campus = jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "https://isa401-find-your-seat.vercel.app/campus.json")

campus$briefing

dplyr::glimpse(campus)
```


```{r}
fsb = campus[['Farmer']] #campus$farmer or campus[[5]]
fsb$code
```
```{r}
names(fsb)

sec_floor = campus$Farmer$floors[["2"]]$sections
sec_floor
```
